waittime_after_release.description:
When will users be able to click watch after the release day of the movie
Measurement: Days(int)
eg: 10 -> users will only be able to watch after 10days of release

wait_after_status.description:
When will users be able to click watch based on the status of of the movie
Measurement: Status(str)
tip: use false to turn off the status check
eg: ended -> users will only able to watch if api-response.[keyword:status] is 'ended'

hide_server_printing.description:
This will prevent printing selected server in the console
.Users can still see if they went to yourdomain.com/sources/sources.json
Measurement : Hidden(bool)
eg : true -> users will not see server name printed in the console

player_disable_rightclick.description:
This will disable right clicks from showing browsers default context menu when inside the media player.
 Users can still see the url from devtools. Measurement : Allow(bool)
eg: true -> users will not be able to use the browsers context menu when right clicked on the media player.

player_disable_popups.description:
This will disable opening any external page from any external player listed in sources/sources.json
This will disable most of the ads from external sites.
Measurements: Disable(bool
eg: true -> disable popups
